description:
crate-jmap-filenode-server/src/backend.rs:144 has:

  /// [`MemoryBackend`]: crate::memory::MemoryBackend

The 'crate::memory' module is gated behind '#[cfg(feature = "memory")]' in src/lib.rs:42-43. Running:

  RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p jmap-filenode-server --no-deps

fails with 'error: unresolved link to crate::memory::MemoryBackend'. The same command with '--features memory' passes.

Fix options:

1. Wrap the doc-link in '#[cfg(feature = "memory")]' if rustdoc tolerates that (it does for module-level doc, less so for trait-method doc).

2. Replace the intra-doc link with a plain literal:
   /// MemoryBackend (when the `memory` feature is enabled)

3. Add a feature-gated reference paragraph at the trait/method docstring level:
   #[cfg(feature = "memory")]
   /// See [`crate::memory::MemoryBackend::get_ancestors`] for the reference impl.
   #[cfg(not(feature = "memory"))]
   /// See `crate::memory::MemoryBackend::get_ancestors` (gated behind `memory` feature) for the reference impl.

Confirmed pre-existing on HEAD c436820; not caused by JMAP-510h.14.1. Surfaced while running 'cargo doc' as part of the pre-commit gate after the test-migration change.

Sibling check: jmap-mail-server likely has the same shape (its memory module is also feature-gated and its backend.rs probably has similar doc-links). If so, fix mail-server first as the canonical, then propagate per workspace AGENTS.md 'Canonical Templates' rule.
title: filenode-server: rustdoc intra-doc link to crate::memory::MemoryBackend breaks without 'memory' feature
